## What's new in Igggy 0.1.29
- **Qwen 3.5 9B writes your notes on a 24 GB Mac with your usual apps open.** Igggy used to start the model only when its whole 7.4 GB was free, which rarely happened during a workday, so notes after a call waited and Apple's model usually wrote them in the end. Now, on a Mac with 24 GB of memory, Qwen starts once about half of that is free and macOS isn't short on memory. When macOS says memory is tight, the note waits and starts at the first check that finds room. Macs with less than 24 GB keep the old check. - **A recording's audio leaves memory once it's transcribed.** Igggy used to hold a finished recording's audio until its note was saved, about 0.66 GB for each hour of the call, and that counted against the room the note writer needs. Now it's let go as soon as the transcript exists. With Keep audio recordings on, it stays until the audio file is saved, and if transcription fails it stays so Try again works.
